title: Valves and outlets prohibited below grade.
officialText:
Potable water outlets and combination stop-and-waste valves shall not be installed
underground or below grade. Freeze-proof yard hydrants that drain the riser into the ground are considered to be stop-and-waste valves.
Exception: Freeze-proof yard hydrants that drain the riser into the ground shall be permitted to be installed, provided that the
potable water supply to such hydrants is protected upstream of the hydrants in accordance with Section 608 and the hydrants are
permanently identified as nonpotable outlets by approved signage that reads as follows: “Caution, Nonpotable Water. Do Not
Drink.”
